events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe, fetch live hub, compare with main
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; (node app/scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3) ; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/t144live.html; grep -c "Two-Month Platform Pass" /tmp/t144live.html; grep -c "1 month, worth" /tmp/t144live.html; gh api repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits/main --jq '.sha[0:9]+" "+.commit.committer.date'; git log -1 --format='%h %ci' -- workshop-plan/index.html workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py; cmp <(git show HEAD:workshop-plan/index.html) /tmp/t144live.html && echo SAME || echo DIFF
